name: Edgar Rice Burroughs' Tarzan and Jane
description: Saved from a plane crash and given supernatural powers, teen Tarzan joins forces with brave city girl Jane to protect his jungle home from threats.

videos.title: A Hero Is Born
videos.overview: After being rescued from a plane crash by gorilla Kala, baby Tarzan receives special medicines that both heal him and give him super animal powers.

videos.title: Tarzan Meet Jane
videos.overview: Now 15, Tarzan, who has eluded capture by poachers for years, befriends Dr. Porter's spirited daughter Jane after saving her from a panther attack.

videos.title: In the Urban Jungle
videos.overview: While navigating the challenges of high school and urban living in London, Tarzan teams up with Jane to uncover an animal trafficking ring.

videos.title: Dangerous Rescue
videos.overview: Tarzan and Jane face off against the animal traffickers, then, with help from Tarzan's grandfather, devise a way to get the panthers back to the wild.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: After Tarzan rescues victims of a suspicious fire at a Greystoke warehouse in London, reporters, including Jane's mom, accuse the earl of negligence.

videos.title: By Air and by Sea
videos.overview: Tarzan, Jane and the earl face more sabotage when they discover someone has planted toxic pesticides at the Greystoke organic farm in Scotland.

videos.title: Chasing the Mastermind
videos.overview: While tracking the mastermind in Morocco, Tarzan and Jane learn that Greystoke bulldozers have been stolen and are headed for Tarzan's jungle village.

videos.title: Showdown in the Jungle
videos.overview: Tarzan and Jane fight to stop the poachers from bulldozing the village, then set off to rescue the kidnapped Kala from a trap.

videos.title: That Day In Rio
videos.overview: When they stumble into a poaching depot in Rio de Janeiro, Jane and Tarzan combine wit and strength to help free the animals from captivity.

videos.title: Into the Rainforest
videos.overview: Tarzan and Jane travel deep into the forest to track down the poachers. But first, they must navigate the treacherous rapids of the Teles Pires River.

videos.title: Too Much Monkey Business
videos.overview: After hearing the Kuro Anowi people's story, Tarzan and Jane set out in search of the poachers' base and find the ruins of a lost civilization.

videos.title: The Ruins
videos.overview: Outwitting the guards inside the ruins, the plucky duo find their way to a control room and discover the scale of the global poaching scheme.

videos.title: Return of the King
videos.overview: Tarzan and Jane fight to put a stop to Dr. Blutgeld's plans, then discover the truth about the legend of the Pellucidar.
